story.title: Sheila Chepkirui and Andreas Almgren Triumph at 2026 NYC Marathon
story.summary: Sheila Chepkirui of Kenya won the women's race, marking her second victory at the New York City Marathon. Sweden's Andreas Almgren claimed the men's title in his debut at the event, which saw participation from around 60,000 runners.

related_stories.title: Judge Dismisses Trump's Defamation Lawsuit Over Epstein Letter
related_stories.summary: A U.S. District Judge has dismissed Donald Trump's $10 billion defamation lawsuit against the Wall Street Journal regarding a letter he allegedly wrote to Jeffrey Epstein. The judge ruled that Trump failed to demonstrate that the defendants made defamatory statements with actual malice, stating he was 'grasping at straws.' The lawsuit was dismissed with prejudice, meaning Trump cannot refile the case.

related_stories.title: Shooting After Alabama Football Game Leaves 1 Dead and 8 Injured
related_stories.summary: A shooting occurred outside Legion Field in Birmingham, Alabama, following a football game, resulting in one death and eight injuries. One of the injured individuals is reported to be in critical condition. This incident is part of a series of violent events reported nationwide over the Halloween weekend.

related_stories.title: FBI Links North Korea to $6.3 Billion Binance Crypto Heist
related_stories.summary: The FBI has attributed the recent $6.3 billion hack of the cryptocurrency exchange Binance to North Korea, specifically identifying a group known as TraderTraitor as responsible for the cyber attack. This incident is noted as the largest cryptocurrency theft in history. Following the breach, Binance has resumed withdrawals and reported that it has covered approximately 90% of the losses incurred by its users.

related_stories.title: Haley Stevens Endorses Mike Rogers Following Withdrawal from El-Sayed Event
related_stories.summary: Haley Stevens has publicly endorsed Republican Mike Rogers for the Michigan Senate seat after being disinvited from an event by Abdul El-Sayed's campaign due to a dispute over an antisemitic advertisement. This endorsement marks a significant shift in the race, potentially impacting El-Sayed's campaign as polls tighten in the final days before the election.
